title: Normalization of the native coefficient pullback
statement: For a weakly étale map g:V→X, the native coefficient map g*R_X→R_V equals the canonical inverse-image/localization comparison followed by the identity-on-functions coefficient localization isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 03CV, 03EK, 0GMW, 03EO and 0E8H; explicit comparison with the native vector-space module construction.

proof.text: Apply the adjunction hom equivalence for actual inverse image, which is injective. The native coefficient map is defined as its inverse image of the lower-star coefficient map.
The inverse-image/localization isomorphism is the canonical comparison between left adjoints to the same lower star. Its adjunction formula identifies the image of the other composite.
Evaluate on sections and use the explicit localization adjunction unit formula. Both resulting maps pull functions back along the same scheme morphism, so they agree definitionally.

proof_origin.place: Explicit native/sectionwise comparison using the cited universal properties and canonical localization maps.
